title: Choice
description: Route messages based on a series of predicates

id.title: Id
id.description: Sets the id of this node

note.title: Note
note.description: Sets the note of this node

description.title: Description
description.description: Sets the description of this node

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Disables this EIP from the route.

precondition.title: Precondition
precondition.description: Indicates whether this Choice EIP is in precondition mode or not. If so its branches (when/otherwise) are evaluated during startup to keep at runtime only the branch that matched.
